title: block-root-delete-target telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the block-root-delete-target guard. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "block-root-delete-target". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO full command string and NO delete target.

tool.description: The invoking tool. Always "Bash": this guard exits without deciding on any other tool_name, so the PowerShell lane never reaches it.

subject.description: Privacy-safe command subject: `Bash:<first-token>`, with leading sudo / env-assignment prefixes stripped and the token basenamed. NEVER the full command, the delete target, or their arguments.

form.description: The matched form when blocked: "root-operand" (a recursive rm whose target normalized to a filesystem root) | "no-preserve-root" (a recursive rm carrying --no-preserve-root, refused whatever the target) | "too-long" (command exceeded the parse cap and was blocked fail-closed). Empty string when the call was allowed (status ok).
